forcedChoices.choice: tú for Jesus' prayer to the Father; 'realm' as 'dominio'
forcedChoices.reason: Prayer to one person uses tú; 'reino' would merge with 'kingdom' in the same prayer.
The closing 'even so' works as an affirmation of the prayer; Spanish needs a verb form.
The message speaks to Abner as tú, but 'hearts' is plural, so it includes Abner's associates.
Jesus speaks to the chief as tú, but his return concerns the whole group of Greeks; the context supports the plural.

forcedChoices.choice: 'come again to you' as 'vuelva a ustedes'; 'told you all' as 'les he dicho todo'
forcedChoices.reason: The return is to all the apostles; 'les ... todo' keeps both readings of 'you all' (all of you, and everything).
Here the word names the events on earth; 'operaciones' (glossary for morontia transactions) and 'transacciones' read as business terms.
